about.title: Specialists in high-performance industrial floors
about.subtitle: Formal operations, technical support and direct commercial communication for industrial and logistics projects.
about.who_p1: BMI9 delivers complete solutions in industrial monolithic floors and polished concrete, combining engineering, technology and high-standard execution. Our commitment is to transform the infrastructure of companies throughout Brazil.
about.who_p2: We work on small, medium and large-scale projects, focused on durability, safety and cost-effectiveness. Every m² executed carries our signature of excellence.
about.mission_desc: Deliver high-strength industrial floors that enhance the performance and operational safety of our clients.
about.vision_desc: Be a national reference and the first choice in advanced solutions for industrial and logistics floors.
about.values_desc: Absolute commitment to results, technical rigor, respect for deadlines, safety and solid partnerships.
about.institutional_desc: BMI9 maintains official service channels and institutional presence for negotiations with clients, partners and technical operations.
about.profile_desc: Focused on industrial floors, polished concrete, base leveling and custom solutions for warehouses, factories and commercial areas.
about.admin_desc: Operations based in São Paulo/SP with commercial support for demands from different regions of Brazil.
about.engineering_desc_about: Projects signed by experienced professionals, with detailed technical dimensioning to withstand severe loads.
about.equipment_desc_about: State-of-the-art machinery fleet, ensuring excellence in concreting, laser leveling and finishing.
about.deadlines_desc_about: Robust planning and optimized logistics, focused on meeting tight schedules while reducing operational impact.
about.quality_desc_about: Extensive portfolio of projects delivered for giants in the logistics and industrial sector across Brazil.
